firmware.title: Android System Update
firmware.description: This software update will upgrade your Android One to Android 6.0, Marshmallow, which delivers major improvements to the functionality and performance of your device. To find out more, visit http://www.android.com/marshmallow. Downloading updates over a mobile network or while roaming may cause additional charges.
